scope: QA-only correction after the actual frozen production native attempt failed on a case-sensitive rendered-text check. No production input changed.
failed_assertion: Paid bottles appear in ordinary inventory and existing aid category
diagnosis: The raw failure screenshot visibly contains AIDE, NUKA-COLA 1 and NUKA-COLA QUANTUM 1. Existing global CSS src/styles.css:11 transforms button text to uppercase; innerText reflects that rendering. The former mixed-case Nuka-Cola substring is not a sound item-presence contract.
old_check:
check('Paid bottles appear in ordinary inventory and existing aid category', debug('v027UI')['sub'] == 'aid'
              and 'Nuka-Cola' in page.locator('#pipContent').inner_text())
new_check:
check('Paid bottles appear in ordinary inventory and existing aid category', debug('v027UI')['sub'] == 'aid'
              and all(page.locator('#pipContent .p27-row[data-arg='+json.dumps(item)+']').is_visible()
                      and state()['inventory'].get(item, 0) == 1 for item in ('nukaCola', 'nukaQuantum')))
preserved_assertions: All actual payment amounts, repair costs, finite reserves, consumption effects, Continue, collision and LOS, actual source geography, focus, mobile bounds and input hash stability checks are unchanged.
